name: PCSX2
short_description: Self-hosted PS2 emulator with web UI for remote gaming and game management.
description: PCSX2 is a self-hosted PlayStation 2 emulator powered by LinuxServer.io, providing a full emulation experience in the browser. Play your PS2 game library from any device with save state support, controller configuration, and graphics tuning.
usecases: Play PlayStation 2 games remotely through a browser without needing a local emulator install.
Manage game ROMs, save states, and emulator configuration from any device.
Access your gaming library on-the-go with synchronized settings and progress.
notes: Shared memory size is set to 1GB which is required for the emulator.
Data persistence is handled through a named Docker volume to preserve game saves and settings.
You will need to provide your own PS2 BIOS files and game ROMs.
